Proposition
[Three-dimensional algebraic lower bound] 1. Proposition 5.2.2\group deformation theorySource: thurston:page-0099, thurston:page-0100 If a hyperbolic $3$--manifold $M$ exists, its small deformation space has dimension at least $6(-\chi (M))$.
Proof

\sketch The relator equations define a complex algebraic fiber in a product of copies of $\PSL (2,\C )$; its dimension is at least variables minus equations. The cell structure gives the stated Euler-characteristic count.

□
